scope: canonical indexable Growth Library protocols and their maintained hierarchy

findings.evidence: Only evidence records with indexable=true receive the layer; their canonical URLs and hierarchy continuation targets must remain in the final sitemap.
Continuation anchors name the Growth Zone, Life Area or ontology Topic and describe the navigation job rather than using generic link text.
Each canonical protocol gains explicit contextual paths back to maintained hierarchy surfaces while existing global navigation remains separate.
Existing Related protocols remains the peer relation graph; the new gate verifies its protocol targets remain indexable instead of recomputing similarity.
Canonical protocol pages already expose visible breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList structured data; this rollout preserves that established contract.
Continue from here connects each protocol to its Growth Zone, Life Area and published ontology Topic, with Growth Library fallback when needed.
Canonical indexable protocol pages expose browser-local Save plus Share, Copy link and Cite controls using their canonical URL.
Cite copies Brali, the visible protocol title and canonical URL; it does not invent an author, DOI, efficacy claim or review outcome.
No Preferred Sources control is published until current source-preference availability and publisher applicability are verified independently.
Final and live checks verify canonical utilities, hierarchy continuation, sitemap targets and indexable-only Related protocol edges after the full generated-site pipeline.
